revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 growth was 15.1% (478,834 vs 416,161, filed), FY2025 6.4%; growth assumed to fade from 7% toward ~4.5% as the base gets large and approaches mature-market growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: slightly below FY2026 filed margin of 33.0% (158,063/478,834); FY2025 was 32.0%, FY2024 31.5%. Held flat for conservatism.

tax_rate.source: Derived from FY2026 filing: (pretax 159,237 - net income 132,175)/159,237 = 17.0% effective rate, accession 0000320193-26-000026. Assumed to persist.

da_pct_revenue.source: FY2026 filed D&A 13,423 / revenue 478,834 = 2.8%; held constant.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2026 filed 1.9% (9,041/478,834), FY2025 3.1%, FY2024 2.4%; 2.0% approximates the 3-year average-ish level, rounded.

wacc.source: Assumption via CAPM: risk-free 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y par yield, 2026-11-06) + beta ~1.1 (my assumption, not retrieved from Damodaran industry data) x US ERP 4.46% (Damodaran, 2026-02-16) = ~9.8% cost of equity; debt is ~2% of capital (net debt 23.4B vs large equity value), so WACC ~9.5% after rounding down slightly for low-leverage/after-tax debt.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate (long-run nominal growth proxy) and in line with long-run US nominal GDP growth less a margin.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 80,111 (LT debt noncurrent 68,208 + current 9,906 + commercial paper 1,997) - cash 36,305 - marketable securities 20,417; accession 0000320193-26-000026

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares 14,720,306,000 (us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding), accession 0000320193-26-000026, expressed in millions
